# @stapel/profiles-react 0.25.0

Headless React flow pair for stapel-profiles (contract >=0.20 <0.21) — business + state, zero visual opinion.
Built on @stapel/core: typed client + StapelApiError envelope, auth token refresh,
verification-403 interception, i18n engine, analytics facade, TanStack Query layer.

## The one right way (do this, the rest is a review/lint smell)
- No raw fetch/axios. The client is injected via <ProfilesProvider>/StapelConfigProvider;
  every hook and flow already carries auth, refresh, and the error envelope.
- Render errors, never try/catch them: a flow's state carries FlowError{code,params};
  render `t(code, params)` and branch on `explainProfilesError(code)` remediation.
- Server state = the use* hooks (query layer); keys come only from profilesQueryKeys.
- User strings = i18n keys (registerProfilesI18n); never string literals.
- Sign-in UI = a headless flow component; copy it (shadcn-style) to restyle.

## Layers
api (typed client) · model (hooks, session) · flows (machines) · headless · i18n

## Documented flows (flows.json — canonical id, steps, endpoints)

## Operations (typed; use the named op, never a path string)
Request/response schema names are in manifest.json + the generated types.
Paths are relative to `/profiles/api/v1/`.
- add_my_contact: POST /contacts
- batch_profiles: POST /batch
- block_user: POST /{user_id}/block
- confirm_contact_verification: POST /contacts/{contact_id}/verify/confirm
- delete_my_contact: DELETE /contacts/{contact_id}
- follow_user: POST /{user_id}/follow
- get_contact_reveal_summary: GET /contacts/{contact_id}/reveals/summary
- get_field_manifest: GET /field-manifest
- get_language: GET /languages/{code}/
- get_my_blocked: GET /me/blocked
- get_my_followers: GET /me/followers
- get_my_following: GET /me/following
- get_my_profile: GET /me
- get_profile: GET /{user_id}
- get_relationship: GET /{user_id}/relationship
- list_languages: GET /languages/
- list_my_contacts: GET /contacts
- request_contact_verification: POST /contacts/{contact_id}/verify/request
- reveal_contacts: POST /contacts/reveal
- unblock_user: POST /{user_id}/unblock
- unfollow_user: POST /{user_id}/unfollow
- unsubscribe_notifications: POST /notifications/unsubscribe
- update_my_contact: PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}
- update_my_profile: PATCH /me

## Query hooks (server state; keys come only from the key factory)
- useLanguages (query) → listLanguages
- useMyBlocked (query) → getMyBlocked
- useMyFollowers (query) → getMyFollowers
- useMyFollowing (query) → getMyFollowing
- useMyProfile (query) → getMyProfile
- useProfile (query) → getProfile
- useProfileFieldManifest (query) → getFieldManifest
- useProfilesBatch (query) → batchProfiles
- useRelationship (query) → getRelationship
- useUpdateMyProfile (mutation) → updateMyProfile

## Errors (render t(code, params); UX from remediation)
67 keys (full catalog: manifest.json §errors). By remediation: fix_input 36 · retry 15 · wait_and_retry 7 · verify 5 · contact_support 2 · reauthenticate 2.
Param-bearing keys (interpolation slots matter):
- error.400.avatar_url_scheme [400] → fix_input {schemes}
- error.400.contacts_invalid_code [400] → fix_input {attempts_remaining}
- error.400.contacts_invalid_policy [400] → fix_input {policies}
- error.400.field.blank [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.does_not_exist [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.invalid_choice [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.max_length [400] → fix_input {field,max_length}
- error.400.field.max_value [400] → fix_input {field,max_value}
- error.400.field.min_length [400] → fix_input {field,min_length}
- error.400.field.min_value [400] → fix_input {field,min_value}
- error.400.field.null [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.required [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.field.unique [400] → fix_input {field}
- error.400.too_many_ids [400] → fix_input {requested,limit}
- error.429.contacts_code_rate [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after}
- error.429.contacts_reveal_budget [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after}
- error.429.rate_limit [429] → wait_and_retry {retry_after_minutes}

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

- profiles.settings-skin → <ProfileSettings> [settings|sections|manifest-failed]  demo/ProfileSettingsSkin.demo.tsx
Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// Error rendering + remediation branch (one pattern for every pair).
const r = explainProfilesError(err.code); // 'wait_and_retry' | 'verify' | ...
return <Alert action={r}>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
